class.name: BoneClothPreset
class.brief_description: The values of a [BoneClothSimulator3D] saved as a resource.
class.description: The values of a [BoneClothSimulator3D] under the same names, without its chains, bones, anchor, [member BoneClothSimulator3D.link_mode] and [member BoneClothSimulator3D.sync/value]. Only values that differ from the simulator's defaults are saved. In the 3D editor, pick one under [b]Presets[/b] in the node's toolbar menu, or save the node's values with [b]Save Preset...[/b]. In code, use [method BoneClothSimulator3D.apply_preset] and [method BoneClothSimulator3D.make_preset]. The plugin includes eight presets in [code]addons/bone_cloth/presets/[/code].
